tools.name: aiCarousels
tools.makes: Carousels, image posts and short videos from an idea, a link, a PDF or a YouTube video
tools.note: Takes many kinds of input and has ghostwriter voices; the free try is one carousel, and it posts only to LinkedIn.

tools.name: BrandBird
tools.makes: LinkedIn and Instagram carousels, plus other social graphics and app store screenshots
tools.apiNote: API page and a JavaScript SDK linked from the footer
tools.note: A design tool first that builds a carousel from a topic or a URL and can translate it; free exports carry a small watermark.

tools.name: CarouselMaker.co
tools.makes: Carousels and infographics from a topic, in many languages
tools.note: A simple topic-to-carousel maker with video and PowerPoint export; the home page names no image or PDF export and no posting.

tools.name: Carousels Generator
tools.makes: Carousels from a topic or a draft, edited in a chat
tools.claimedFrom: Product Hunt listing (the site says it publishes and schedules but names no network)
tools.note: You edit slides by chatting and can import a brand from a website or a PDF; its own page does not name the networks it posts to.

tools.name: Contentdrips
tools.makes: Carousels, quote cards, infographics and other social graphics
tools.apiNote: REST API and MCP server; the pricing page lists them on the Pro plan
tools.claimedFrom: a comparison article found in search; contentdrips.com does not name its export formats
tools.note: Templates plus AI for carousels and graphics, with an API and MCP server for automation; the free plan is small.

tools.name: ContentIn
tools.makes: LinkedIn PDF carousels and static carousels, inside a LinkedIn writing and scheduling suite
tools.apiNote: MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor on paid plans; a free agent tier only schedules and publishes
tools.note: Fits LinkedIn creators who want carousels next to post writing and scheduling; the web app has a trial, not a free plan.

tools.name: PostNitro
tools.makes: Carousels, single-image posts and short animated posts on a brand kit
tools.apiNote: REST API, CLI and an MCP server with 40 tools, as an add-on or in higher plans
tools.note: Makes carousels for seven networks and posts to six of them; scheduling and the API need a paid plan.

tools.name: Postiv
tools.makes: LinkedIn PDF carousels, inside a LinkedIn content and scheduling tool
tools.note: Its free carousel maker needs no sign-up and exports a 1080x1350 PDF; the free maker does not post, so you upload the file yourself.

tools.name: Supergrow
tools.makes: Branded LinkedIn carousels from a post, inside a LinkedIn writing and scheduling suite
tools.apiNote: MCP server on Pro; API on Enterprise
tools.note: Fits LinkedIn creators who want carousels bundled with a calendar and a queue; the full tool has a trial, and a separate free generator page exists.

tools.name: Taplio
tools.makes: LinkedIn PDF carousels and posts, with scheduling and analytics
tools.apiNote: MCP server to search ideas and create or fetch drafts from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
tools.note: Fits LinkedIn-only creators who want carousels inside a full growth suite; it has a trial, not a free plan.

tools.name: Typegrow
tools.makes: LinkedIn carousels and posts, with scheduling
tools.note: A LinkedIn-only tool that says it is free for now while a paid plan is in development; its pages name no export formats.

tools.name: WaveGen
tools.makes: LinkedIn PDF carousels, with a free maker that needs no sign-up
tools.note: Built around LinkedIn PDF carousels with direct publishing; other platforms are named but described in less detail.

tools.name: ChatSlide
tools.makes: Presentations, with a social post mode that makes carousels as numbered images or one PDF
tools.note: A presentation tool with a social post mode that uses stock images; you download the files and post them yourself.

tools.name: Decktopus
tools.makes: AI presentations that can also be LinkedIn and Instagram carousels
tools.apiNote: Remote MCP server for Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT; the plan is not stated
tools.note: A presentation tool first, with carousels as one output; it does not post to social networks.

tools.name: PostEverywhere
tools.makes: A scheduler with an AI studio for LinkedIn carousels and TikTok slideshows
tools.apiNote: API and hosted MCP server on every plan; the page does not say whether carousel making is exposed
tools.note: A scheduler first that generates image carousels and slideshows from a prompt; it has a trial, not a free plan.

tools.name: Blotato
tools.makes: Carousels, slideshows, infographics, quote cards and avatar videos
tools.apiNote: Hosted MCP server, REST API and n8n and Make nodes, not in the trial
tools.claimedFrom: search summaries of help.blotato.com template pages
tools.note: One tool to make and post many formats to nine networks, with nodes for n8n and Make; the home page names no download formats.

tools.name: CineRads
tools.makes: TikTok slideshows built from a product web page
tools.note: Fits online shops that want slideshows made from a product URL; the free start is three generations in total.

tools.name: Faceless
tools.makes: TikTok photo slideshows and Instagram carousels from your photos
tools.note: The free browser maker puts your text on your photos with no sign-up and no AI; AI hooks and auto-posting are paid.

tools.name: Genviral
tools.makes: TikTok and Instagram slideshows, plus UGC-style videos, ads and App Store screenshots
tools.apiNote: REST API, CLI and a remote MCP server with 33 tools on every plan
tools.note: Built for app marketers who want an AI agent to make and post slideshows; sign-up is free, but every plan is paid.

tools.name: ReelFarm
tools.makes: TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels, plus UGC-style videos
tools.apiNote: REST API and an MCP server with 23 tools; the MCP docs say the MCP itself does not post
tools.note: Fits marketers who copy proven TikTok slideshow formats and run accounts on autopilot; it finds images on the web instead of making them.

tools.name: ReelMoney
tools.makes: TikTok photo slideshows and short faceless videos, with scheduling
tools.apiNote: MCP endpoint with a key: agents can make, schedule and read TikTok stats
tools.note: Fits small businesses that want scheduled TikTok slideshows from ready image packs; Instagram is listed as coming soon.

tools.name: SendShort
tools.makes: TikTok photo slideshows from saved formats, posted on a schedule
tools.apiNote: MCP and agent apps can list and schedule slideshows, not make new ones
tools.note: Fits creators who want a repeatable TikTok photo series with a review step before posting; TikTok only.

tools.name: SlideFarm
tools.makes: TikTok slideshows on your own images, in a phone app
tools.note: Fits phone-first creators who bring their own images; the AI writes the text and it posts through TikTok, but it makes no images.

tools.name: SlideReels
tools.makes: TikTok and Instagram slideshows, plus UGC-style product videos
tools.note: AI images and slides in one place with publishing to TikTok; the page offers the first slideshows free but does not describe a lasting free plan.

tools.name: Slideshows.Studio
tools.makes: Five-slide vertical slideshows with a hook, a caption and hashtags
tools.note: Quick AI slides from a URL for people who post with another tool; it does not schedule or post.

tools.name: SlideStorm
tools.makes: TikTok slideshows with AI images and captions
tools.apiNote: API guide linked from the site
tools.note: Aimed at faceless accounts and app promoters, with many slideshows per prompt; the free plan covers the editor, and AI slides use credits.

tools.name: Viraloop
tools.makes: Slideshows and about 20 other formats, such as UGC videos, memes and ads
tools.apiNote: REST API, hosted MCP server, CLI and an agent skill on paid plans
tools.note: Fits brands that want many formats made and posted from one profile built from their website; the free start is ten posts once.

tools.name: Wavegrain
tools.makes: TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels from a topic, a website or a post you like
tools.apiNote: Posting API under /api/v1 and a Carousel API in the docs, with access keys; an MCP server with 79 tools makes and schedules slideshows
tools.note: Built for photo-led slideshows from your own photos or AI images, with approval before posting; it posts only to TikTok and YouTube.

tools.name: Adobe Express
tools.makes: Multi-page social posts that work as carousels, among many other designs
tools.apiNote: Express API through Firefly Services, by request; its MCP server serves developer docs, not designs
tools.claimedFrom: search results; the Instagram post page lists no file formats and no carousel page exists
tools.note: Good for teams already on Adobe; a carousel is a multi-page project, and Adobe has no dedicated carousel generator.

tools.name: Canva
tools.makes: Carousels as multi-page designs from templates, among almost any other design
tools.apiNote: Connect REST API and a remote MCP server that create, edit, resize and export designs
tools.claimedFrom: search results of canva.com template and feature pages, which blocked our reader; the API, MCP and export facts are from canva.dev
tools.note: A very large template library and a full design editor, where you build each slide yourself; we could not confirm that its Content Planner posts carousels.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.makes: Presentations, documents and web pages, with a Social format for carousel cards
tools.apiNote: REST API with keys on every plan, and a hosted MCP server
tools.claimedFrom: search results of gamma.app guides, which blocked our reader; the API and MCP facts are from developers.gamma.app
tools.note: Turns text or a document into designed cards; social carousels are one format of many, and you post them yourself.

tools.name: Ocoya
tools.makes: Carousels designed in its studio and posted to Instagram or as LinkedIn PDF documents
tools.apiNote: REST API with SDKs and an MCP server; the docs do not show carousel support
tools.note: A scheduler with AI writing and a design studio that posts to many networks; it has a trial, not a free plan.

tools.name: Piktochart
tools.makes: AI carousels for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, plus infographics and presentations
tools.claimedFrom: search results of piktochart.com carousel pages, which blocked our reader
tools.note: An infographic tool that added AI carousel makers; it exports files for you to post yourself.

tools.name: Pippit
tools.makes: Photo slideshow videos and carousel templates, plus AI video and image tools
tools.note: From the makers of CapCut; good for turning your photos into slideshow videos, but its slideshows are videos rather than photo posts.

tools.name: Predis.ai
tools.makes: Carousels with slide text, caption and hashtags, plus ads, posts and videos
tools.apiNote: REST API with a LinkedIn carousel endpoint, and an MCP server with a carousel preset that does not post
tools.note: Fast prompt-to-carousel with scheduling, aimed at marketers and ads; it has a short trial, and its pages name no export formats.

tools.name: Simplified
tools.makes: Editable AI carousels from a topic, inside a design, writing and scheduling suite
tools.apiNote: REST API and a hosted MCP server; the MCP page does not mention carousels
tools.claimedFrom: search results of simplified.com scheduler pages
tools.note: An all-in-one suite for small teams that writes, designs and schedules; the free plan limits accounts and scheduled posts.

tools.name: Venngage
tools.makes: AI carousels and carousel templates, exported as images or a PDF
tools.note: A simple topic-to-slides flow with a brand kit; it ends at the export and has no scheduler.

tools.name: VistaCreate
tools.makes: Instagram carousel templates and multi-page designs, scheduled as one carousel post
tools.apiNote: API suite for the editor, templates and stock library, sold on request
tools.claimedFrom: search results of support.create.vista.com help articles, which blocked our reader
tools.note: A template editor with AI text and image tools and a scheduler for business accounts; carousels are built by hand from templates.

tools.name: Visme
tools.makes: Instagram carousel posts from templates, plus presentations, documents and charts
tools.note: Also makes charts, documents and presentations; carousels come from templates, and the free plan adds a watermark.

openSource.name: Open Carrusel
openSource.makes: Instagram carousels exported as PNG at Instagram sizes
openSource.note: A local Next.js app where you design slides by chatting with Claude, then export PNGs.

openSource.name: SlideSmith
openSource.makes: TikTok and Instagram slideshows, scheduled through a posting service
openSource.note: A local dashboard that writes slideshows with a language model; the noncommercial license rules out business use.

openSource.name: Vertica
openSource.makes: Image and video carousels, exported as PDF, numbered JPGs or MP4
openSource.note: A small local studio where each deck is a JSON file that you write by hand or paste from an AI chat.

openSource.name: mkcr
openSource.makes: LinkedIn carousel PDFs and PNGs from HTML and Tailwind
openSource.note: A Go command-line tool meant for AI agents to render carousel files from HTML, with no visual editor.

openSource.name: ALIGNED
openSource.makes: Instagram carousels laid out on one continuous canvas, for Mac and Windows
openSource.note: A free desktop editor for carousels where one image runs across all the slides; you design by hand, without AI.

openSource.name: open-larryloop
openSource.makes: TikTok and Instagram carousel slides, with publishing
openSource.note: A young project that generates and publishes slides; we read its README, not its code.

openSource.name: tiktok-carousel-generator
openSource.makes: Vertical carousel slides with AI-written text
openSource.note: A Python script for making slides in batches; a small project with one main author.

openSource.name: Satori
openSource.makes: Turns HTML and CSS written as JSX into SVG, so slides can be rendered from code
openSource.note: The usual engine for rendering slide images from React components without a browser; it supports a subset of CSS.

openSource.name: Remotion
openSource.makes: Videos and animated slideshows from React code
openSource.note: The common choice for video slideshows from code; larger companies need a paid company license.

openSource.name: Puppeteer
openSource.makes: Headless Chrome that screenshots HTML slides or prints them to a multi-page PDF
openSource.note: Not made for carousels, but a common way to turn HTML slides into PNGs or a LinkedIn PDF.

openSource.name: Slidev
openSource.makes: Slide decks written in Markdown, exported to PDF or PNG
openSource.note: A presentation tool for developers that also works for PDF carousels once you set the page size.

openSource.name: slidev-theme-linkedin-carousel
openSource.makes: A Slidev theme for LinkedIn carousels
openSource.note: Lets you write a LinkedIn carousel in Markdown and export a PDF; you need to be at home with Node tools.

openSource.name: Marp CLI
openSource.makes: Markdown slides converted to PDF, PNG or PPTX
openSource.note: A simple Markdown to PDF or image route for carousels; you set the slide size yourself.

openSource.name: react-pdf
openSource.makes: PDF files built from React components
openSource.note: Renders multi-page PDFs from React, which suits LinkedIn document posts; layout and text only.
